informal_statement:
For any real center \((c_x,c_y)\) and real \(R\), the set
\[
\{(x,y):(x-c_x)^2+(y-c_y)^2\leq R^2\}
\]
is bounded.
reason: Source `CMVElementaryGeometry.lean:390-406`: The boundedness statement permits any real radius symbol because its square determines the disk; the author does not add positivity.
